messages.subject: Project Indigo — COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All — I'm pleased to confirm that the Series B financing of Halcyon Photonics completed today. £18,000,000 has been raised; Brindley Growth Partners has subscribed £14,000,000, Aldridge Seed £3,000,000 (including conversion of its loan note) and co-investors the balance. The executed Subscription & Shareholders' Agreement and the completion board minutes are attached. Eleanor is appointed as Investor Director with effect from today. We'll file SH01 and the amended Articles at Companies House this week and circulate the final cap table. Congratulations to the team.

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Corporate & Financing
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 1100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
